moby/profiles — seccomp default profile
=======================================

This product embeds Docker's own default seccomp profile, verbatim and unmodified, as the
managed resource `XE_Local_AI_Engine.Client.Application/Services/Sandbox/Container/seccomp-default.json`
inside `XE-Local-AI-Engine.Client.Application.dll`. It is applied to every sandbox container
the engine creates, so that the container's confinement can be read back and verified rather
than assumed from the daemon's default.

  Upstream repository: https://github.com/moby/profiles
  Upstream file:       seccomp/default.json
  Upstream tag:        seccomp/v0.2.3
  Immutable commit:    836ae4d37ef2ec995c77c99fc55f5b5f3af3a897
  Source archive:      https://github.com/moby/profiles/archive/836ae4d37ef2ec995c77c99fc55f5b5f3af3a897.tar.gz
  Embedded bytes:      SHA-256 536529b665dd0972c37bfb569f5d4ac8a53592e7b00752bc39ff063ca9864c74
